description: Ashley reveals that Bjarne stood her up on Friday. A dismissive response can delay the clue until the player acknowledges the impact.

openingMessages.speaker: Ashley
openingMessages.text: I've been thinking about what happened. I don't know why I keep expecting you to understand when you never seem to listen.

choices.text: I know I let you down. Were we supposed to meet somewhere?
I was probably busy. You know how work gets.

lines.speaker: Ashley
lines.text: ...Yes, Bjarne. Friday evening. We were supposed to meet at that little Italian restaurant on Fourth Street.

lines.speaker: Ashley
lines.text: I waited there for almost an hour. I called you twice. You never showed up.

choices.text: I'm so sorry. I don't know what happened.
I wish you'd told me how important it was.
I can't believe I did that.

lines.speaker: Ashley
lines.text: I know exactly how work gets. That's the problem, Bjarne.

lines.speaker: Ashley
lines.text: You're always busy. But I guess I shouldn't have expected you to make time for me.

choices.text: I didn't mean to hurt you.
Were we supposed to meet on Friday?

lines.speaker: Ashley
lines.text: Yes. Friday evening, at the Italian place on Fourth Street.

lines.speaker: Ashley
lines.text: I waited for almost an hour and called twice. You never came.

choices.text: I'm sorry. I should have been there.

lines.speaker: Ashley
lines.text: I DID. Twice. I called you, Bjarne. I texted you. I waited for an hour.

lines.speaker: Ashley
lines.text: I don't know what else you expected me to do.

lines.speaker: Pragmatist
lines.text: So we stood someone up. Not ideal. Perhaps fewer calendar-related crimes next time.

choices.text: I didn't realize you called twice. I'm sorry.
I still don't see why this is such a big deal.

lines.speaker: Ashley
lines.text: I know you can be forgetful, but this was different.

lines.speaker: Ashley
lines.text: I was really looking forward to seeing you.

choices.text: I wish I could remember. I hate that I hurt you.

lines.speaker: Ashley
lines.text: I shouldn't have had to explain that. We agreed to meet. I thought that was enough.

lines.speaker: Ashley
lines.text: I couldn't believe it either. I kept telling myself there must have been a reason.

choices.text: I wish I could explain what happened.

lines.speaker: Ashley
lines.text: Maybe not. But it still hurts.

lines.speaker: Ashley
lines.text: I know. I just wanted you to show up because you wanted to be there.

lines.speaker: Ashley
lines.text: Then I don't know what else to say to you right now.

lines.speaker: Detective
lines.text: Friday evening. A scheduled meeting. Two unanswered calls. We need to understand what that meeting was meant to accomplish.

lines.speaker: Grand Architect
lines.text: This isn't a bug to patch with an apology. She needs to know you understand why it hurt.

lines.speaker: Ashley
lines.text: I need some time, Bjarne. We'll talk later.
